policy.actual: VVPQ METAR/SPECI + independent WMO 48917 SYNOP + VRain gauges, each only when its own timestamped observation is fresh and eligible.
policy.estimated_now: Observation-anchored local analysis. Ensemble spread/disagreement modulates background uncertainty; ensemble is not treated as an observation.
policy.marine: MODEL_ONLY until a usable in-situ marine feed is available.
policy.feedback: Field feedback calibrates categorical/event errors and later numeric coefficients; it never rewrites raw observations.
